extracted_concepts.name: Product Rule
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: If f and g are differentiable, d/dx[f(x)g(x)] = f'(x)g(x) + f(x)g'(x).

extracted_concepts.name: Quotient Rule
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: If f and g are differentiable and g(x) ≠ 0, d/dx[f(x)/g(x)] = [f'(x)g(x) - f(x)g'(x)]/[g(x)]².

extracted_concepts.name: Derivative
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The derivative measures the rate of change of a function and is denoted f'(x) or d/dx.

extracted_concepts.name: Differentiable
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A function is differentiable if its derivative exists.

extracted_concepts.name: Leibniz notation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Notation for derivatives using d/dx, such as d/dx(uv) and d/dx(u/v).

extracted_concepts.name: Product of functions
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A function formed by multiplying functions, such as f(x)g(x) or uvw.

extracted_concepts.name: Quotient of functions
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A function formed by dividing one function by another, such as f(x)/g(x) or u/v.

extracted_concepts.name: Extended Product Rule
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Product Rule extended to three or more functions: d/dx(uvw) = u'vw + uv'w + uvw'.

extracted_concepts.name: Second derivative
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The derivative of the derivative, written f''(x) or d²f/dx².

extracted_concepts.name: Higher-order derivatives
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Derivatives beyond the first, such as f''(x), f'''(x), and f⁽⁴⁾(x).

extracted_concepts.name: Position function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A function s(t) describing the position of an object at time t.

extracted_concepts.name: Velocity
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The first derivative of position: s'(t) = v(t).

extracted_concepts.name: Acceleration
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The second derivative of position: s''(t) = a(t).

extracted_concepts.name: Jerk
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The third derivative of position: s'''(t).

extracted_concepts.name: Derivative function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: If f is differentiable, its derivative f' is also a function.

extracted_concepts.name: Differential operator d/dx
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The operator d/dx used to denote differentiation with respect to x.

extracted_concepts.name: Nonzero denominator condition
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The Quotient Rule requires g(x) ≠ 0.

extracted_concepts.name: Third derivative
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The derivative after the second derivative, written f'''(x) or s'''(t).

extracted_concepts.name: Fourth derivative
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The derivative after the third derivative, written f⁽⁴⁾(x).

extracted_concepts.name: Physical interpretation of derivatives
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Derivatives of position correspond to velocity, acceleration, and jerk.

extracted_concepts.name: Memory aid for the Quotient Rule
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: "Low d-high minus high d-low, all over the square of what's below."
